patterns.note: Full-bleed sections with distinct background colors (red, white, light pink) are used to segment content vertically, creating clear visual breaks.
Oversized, wide, and bold sans-serif typography is used for primary headings, creating a strong, playful statement, contrasted with smaller, standard sans-serif for body text.

A vibrant, high-contrast color palette features a dominant bright red for the hero, black for primary text, and white for backgrounds, accented by a range of pastel and bright colors in illustrations.

The primary navigation bar is sticky, remaining at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls. It visually transforms from white text on a red background within the hero to black text on a white background when scrolling over other content sections.
Illustrative, character-driven graphics are integrated directly into content sections, acting as visual anchors and adding a playful, branded element to descriptions of services and calls to action.

technique_notes: The header is implemented as a sticky element that changes its text color and background appearance based on the scroll position, specifically when transitioning from the hero section to subsequent content.
Content sections utilize full-width backgrounds with distinct colors to create visual separation and guide the user's eye down the page.
Large, custom illustrations are used as hero elements and integrated within content blocks to convey brand personality and break up text-heavy areas.

design_tokens.type_scale: The hero heading is extremely oversized (~6x body text) with a wide, bold character, while subheadings are large but more contained, and body text is a standard, legible sans-serif.
design_tokens.radius: Rounded corners are consistently applied to interactive elements like buttons and cards, with a very high radius (approaching pill-shaped) for a soft, playful feel.
design_tokens.spacing: The hero section is very airy, emphasizing the large typography and illustrations. Subsequent content sections maintain a balanced density with generous vertical padding between blocks.

standout: This site's design is distinctive for its bold, almost cartoonish, oversized typography paired with a vibrant, playful illustration style that permeates every section. The interactive 'How can we help you?' buttons in the hero also offer a unique engagement point.
